body.value: One date, and it is the whole answer: 2013-12-05, the earliest closing date recorded against any of Contoso's 16 ceased physical shops — the day the first-ever shop closure happened. That shop was Contoso Store Rhode Island, open since 2005-04-04. NOT INCLUDED: the 57 shops still trading and the online outlet, none of which carry a closing date; and no sales figure at all — this is a date read off the store dimension, nothing is summed or averaged. WHAT THE DATA WILL NOT TELL YOU: why it closed, beyond the single word the source recorded, which here is 'Restructured' — the site was rebuilt or re-let rather than given up. So Contoso's first closure was a restructuring; if you meant only shops shut for good, the date is 2015-05-05.
